## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior, and final behavior. Identify affected subsystems and the relevant issue.

## Shared interfaces

List any changes to units, zero/direction, reduction ratio, limits, pins, configuration schema, protocol, or assembly geometry. State which derived firmware/model/CAD files were regenerated.

## Validation actually executed

| Command or procedure | Test subject | Result | Evidence location |
|---|---|---|---|

Label each result as software test, simulation, calculation, manufacturer specification, physical bench measurement, or wearing measurement. Do not substitute a target or synthetic result for hardware evidence.

## Remaining verification

List unexecuted checks and unresolved assumptions, including structural strength, motor/driver thermal behavior, calibration, and fit when relevant.

## Documentation and sources

State documentation updates, applicable directory licenses, and any third-party material/notices added or changed. Exclude credentials, personal information, compiler caches, and unrelated local artifacts.
